name: WebGL post-process pipeline
oneLiner: The game keeps drawing on its own 2D canvas; each frame that canvas becomes a texture on a WebGL layer laid exactly over it, and a chain of fragment-shader passes runs at device resolution: a filmic grade with split toning and vignette, and a chromatic hit-pulse on hits. A pass registry lets later elements (bloom, colour LUT, 2D lights, depth of field) add their own passes and extra input textures. Without WebGL, or with ?webgl=0, nothing changes: the 2D canvas shows exactly as before.
fits: any browser game drawn on one 2D canvas, pixel or HD, any resolution and CSS scaling
the base for J-family light and post elements
notFor: games already drawn with WebGL or a 3D engine (add passes to their own pipeline instead)
games split over several stacked canvases (post-process only the one passed in)
a canvas with transparent areas that show the page behind it (the overlay is opaque)
cross-origin images drawn without CORS (a tainted canvas cannot be uploaded; the module turns itself off)

needs: the canvas element the game draws on (any size, any CSS scaling)
render() once per drawn frame on every draw path (before or after the game's own drawing)
optional: the game's step-counted clock in ms (deterministic ?t=&freeze=1)
optional: HUD rects in canvas px (uiRects) or a shared uiMask input canvas: HUD pixels are never graded or colour-split
optional: hit events with a contact point in canvas px (the hit pulse)
optional: extra input canvases (depth map, light mask) for later passes
provides: a post-processing stage over the game canvas (WebGL2 / WebGL1; without WebGL the plain 2D canvas)
pass registry: addPass / enable / set / get / passes, ping-pong buffers, named outputs, setInput slots for J-family elements
pulse(strength, {at}): chromatic hit-pulse fading in game time
stats(): mode, frames, passes, overlay size, frame cost

assets: module/webgl-post.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_Post): overlay layout, texture upload, pass registry, ping-pong buffers, input slots, built-in grade and pulse passes, no-WebGL / lost-context fallback, render watchdog
checks/robust.py: browser robustness checks (alignment, resize, dpr, call order, watchdog, lost context, bad shaders, ?webgl=0, no WebGL, determinism)

module.skin: optional: the vignette fades to the skin's palette.ink when skin-api.js is loaded and a skin is passed
